'''''Jaina's Light''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] piloted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] circa [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]]. Solo claimed to [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Deyd Llnewe|Llnewe]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that it was named after [[Jaina (Elder)|his mother]]. At the time, the ship was supposedly en route to a small backwater farming world. Solo piloted three separate but identical CR90 corvettes (all bearing the same name) in what turned out to be a ship smuggling operation.
